name: CApp_Constructor
summary: Constructs CApp: stores CApp_vtbl, duplicates two strings and the data-manager version string, installs a low-level keyboard hook, resets g_pCamera and creates g_pEnv.
evidence: Stores &CApp_vtbl into *this and returns this; SetWindowsHookExA(13=WH_KEYBOARD_LL); 'Version Error' fallback string; CEnv_Constructor; called from the CDx/CApp creation routine 0x100161B0.

name: App_ForceForegroundWindow
summary: Forces the game window to the foreground: attaches thread input, temporarily zeroes the foreground lock timeout, calls SetForegroundWindow and restores the timeout; skipped unless window mode is 0.
evidence: AttachThreadInput + SystemParametersInfoA(0x2000 SPI_GETFOREGROUNDLOCKTIMEOUT / 0x2001 SPI_SETFOREGROUNDLOCKTIMEOUT) + SetForegroundWindow. It is gated on g_timeOfDayTintEnabled==0, but that global is the window-mode value (see 0x100165B0), not a tint flag.

name: CApp_RunMainLoop
summary: CApp main loop: initialises CDx and input, creates the app/camera object, runs App_InitScene until done, then pumps PeekMessage and renders frames until WM_QUIT, finally running shutdown.
evidence: Member of CApp; CDx_Initialize; App_Constructor (0x33C bytes) -> g_pCamera; PeekMessageA/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageA loop; exits on msg 18 (WM_QUIT); VK_SNAPSHOT (44) on WM_KEYUP/WM_SYSKEYDOWN copies a string to the clipboard; calls 0x10001B50 (render) each loop.

name: App_PreTranslateInputMessage
summary: Per-message input pre-handler called before TranslateMessage: forwards IME messages (0x10F, 0x281-0x283), WM_CHAR/WM_ACTIVATE/WM_KEYDOWN to the input and IME objects and mouse messages (0x200-0x20A) to the mouse handler, with client-area coordinate scaling.
evidence: Switch on message ids 0x102, 6, 0x100 (with VK 229/ImmGetVirtualKey), 0x10F, 0x281-0x283, 0x200-0x20A (mouse buttons/wheel to dword_104E1D4C handlers); GetWindowRect + GetSystemMetrics(32/33/4) frame correction; only caller is CApp_RunMainLoop before TranslateMessage.

name: App_RenderFrameMaskedFPU
summary: Masks all FPU exceptions, calls Frame_Render(g_pCamera), restores the FPU control word, and on success runs an update on off_103601BC; returns success.
evidence: _control87(0x8001F,0x8001F) around Frame_Render(g_pCamera); called from CApp_RunMainLoop and the window proc 0x10016870.

name: App_CreateInputSystem
summary: Allocates a 0xDC4-byte input object into dword_10455C20, constructs it and initialises it with the HINSTANCE.
evidence: Allocator_Generic(0xDC4); ctor 0x10005660 zeroes two 256-byte key-state buffers; init 0x100058F0 takes the HINSTANCE (as DirectInput creation does); dword_10455C20 receives WM_CHAR/WM_ACTIVATE in App_PreTranslateInputMessage; neighbouring unit is DirectInput.

name: CApp_CopyTextToClipboard
summary: Copies a string to the Windows clipboard as CF_TEXT using the app's HWND.
evidence: GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE|GMEM_DDESHARE)/lstrcpyA/OpenClipboard(this->hwnd at +0x18)/EmptyClipboard/SetClipboardData(1=CF_TEXT); called on the PrintScreen key in CApp_RunMainLoop.

name: App_SetCommandLine
summary: Stores a heap copy of the given string in dword_103D3C88 (the command line), returning 0 on allocation failure.

evidence: For each vec3: M1 then M2, w stored at out+8, 1/|w| (w=0->1), x=(x/w+1)*a6, y=(1-y/w)*a7; 12-byte output stride; CMoProcessor vf032.

name: CMoProcessor_CalcScreenBounds
summary: Computes the screen-space bounding rectangle of a strided point array under a matrix and the current view-projection.
evidence: Transforms by a5 then g_pResourceMng+2832 matrix, scales by viewport half size (+3520/+3524), tracks min/max starting from +-10000; writes [minX,minY,maxX,maxY]; uses g_pProcessor scratch matrix stack.

name: CMoProcessor_ProjectVertsAndBounds
summary: Projects 9-float vertices to screen, writing screen x/y into each vertex (+28/+32), and returns their bounding rectangle.
evidence: Two matrix transforms, perspective divide, scale by a6/a7, stores into a2[7]/a2[8], min/max into a1; CMoProcessor vf033.

name: CMoProcessor_CalcScreenBoundsAndVisible
summary: Computes the screen bounds and depth range of a point set and counts points that land inside the viewport.
evidence: Builds combined matrix via g_pProcessor vtbl+36(a5,a6); tracks z/w min/max into this+678/679 and counts points within [0,2*a7]x[0,2*a8] into this+677; rect into a2.

name: CMoResource_AddRefChain
